verified_facts.text: The resort is on a private island surrounded by rainforest and white-sand beaches, overlooking the Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by verdant rainforest and white-sand beaches on a private island, The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort overlooks the alluring waves of the Indian Ocean.

verified_facts.text: The resort's address is Vommuli Island, Dhaalu Atoll, Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vommuli Island, Dhaalu Atoll, Maldives, 13080

verified_facts.text: Resort transfers are mandatory; the round-trip shared seaplane transfer is approximately 45 minutes from the airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Resort transfers mandatory: The round-trip shared seaplane transfer fee is USD 870 per person, (approx. 45 minutes from the airport).

verified_facts.text: For flights arriving after 3:30 PM, an overnight stay in Male is required.
verified_facts.excerpt: For flights arriving after 3:30 PM, an overnight stay in Male’ is required.

verified_facts.text: The villas are split between on-land and over-water villas, each with a private terrace and pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: each of the 33 on-land and 44 over-water luxury private villas at our island resort in the Maldives promises picturesque ocean or garden views from private terraces and pools

verified_facts.text: Garden Villas sit within the island's jungle canopy and have a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: our 150 sqm (1,614 sqft) Garden Villas offer a rare, secluded immersion within the island's lush jungle canopy. Featuring a King bed, a private pool, and legendary St. Regis Butler Service

verified_facts.text: The John Jacob Astor Estate is a two-level, three-bedroom overwater estate whose design was inspired by manta rays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the graceful manta rays that glide through the lagoon, the design of this two-level, three-bedroom estate seamlessly blends modern elegance with the natural beauty of the Maldives.

verified_facts.text: The John Jacob Astor Estate has a cinema room, a private gym and a dedicated space for spa treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside, the villa features a state-of-the-art cinema room, a fully equipped private gym, and a dedicated space for personalized spa treatments

verified_facts.text: Overwater villas are shaped like manta rays and built mainly from cross laminated wood rather than traditional thatch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Instead of the traditional thatched bungalows, overwater villas here are shaped like manta rays and made from predominantly cross laminated wood

verified_facts.text: The library is shaped to swirl upward like a cone shell.
verified_facts.excerpt: the impressively large library swirls into the sky like a cone shell

verified_facts.text: The Whale Bar sits over the water and is shaped to resemble a whale shark.
verified_facts.excerpt: sitting over the Indian Ocean and shaped to resemble a whale shark

verified_facts.text: The Whale Bar serves Latin-inspired tapas and cocktails and hosts a Champagne Sabering ritual at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched over turquoise waters, The Whale Bar bursts with South American spirit at sunset. Enjoy Latin-inspired tapas, cocktails, and DJ sets in a lively oceanfront celebration featuring our signature Champagne Sabering Ritual

verified_facts.text: T-Pan serves modern Japanese kaiseki with limited seating, paired with Dassai sakes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience modern Japanese Kaiseki at T•Pan, an intimate haven with limited seating. Each course showcases seasonal ingredients in perfect harmony, paired with premium Dassai sakes

verified_facts.text: Decanter is a hidden wine cellar offering a six-course menu with paired wines on select evenings.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hidden wine cellar offers an intimate fine-dining restaurant experience in the Maldives with hand-picked vintages and a refined six-course menu.

verified_facts.text: Crust & Craft is a family-friendly beachside venue serving hand-crafted pizzas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our family-friendly beachside venue is the perfect spot for everyday favorites and hand-crafted pizzas

verified_facts.text: The Island Mary is the resort's take on the Bloody Mary, made with kala namak salt.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Island Mary complements the classic ingredients of a traditional Bloody Mary with kala namak salt, a distinctive seasoning popular in South Asian cuisine

verified_facts.text: Iridium Spa is an overwater spa with six treatment suites, including two Ayurvedic suites with private steam rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each of the six treatment suites at our Maldives spa resort, including two Ayurvedic suites with private steam rooms

verified_facts.text: Spa visits begin in the Iridium Room, where guests watch marine life through glass floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each visit begins in our serene Iridium Room, where guests sip Iridium tea while watching vibrant marine life through glass floors.

verified_facts.text: The Blue Hole Pool is a hydrotherapy pool with whirlpool jets on the spa's covered terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated on our covered terrace, our Blue Hole Pool is one of the most expansive hydrotherapy pools in the Maldives. An array of whirlpool jets melt away tension

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments use Biologique Recherche products.
verified_facts.excerpt: our spa treatments are enhanced by Biologique Recherche products

verified_facts.text: Norma is the resort's private yacht, inspired by John Jacob Astor IV's yacht Nourmahal, designed for up to eight guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by Nourmahal, the beloved yacht of John Jacob Astor IV, Norma embodies the spirit of refined adventure and indulgence. Designed for up to eight guests

verified_facts.text: Norma can be chartered for direct and overnight transfers to and from Velana International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Norma may be chartered for exclusive direct and overnight transfers from and to Velana International Airport (MLE) or across other resorts in the Maldives.

verified_facts.text: The dive centre reaches over 40 dive sites around the atoll, and there is a house reef for snorkeling.
verified_facts.excerpt: With over 40 distinguished dive sites encircling the atoll, our Vommuli Dive & Watersports Centre opens a world of manta glides, reef gardens, and cerulean depths. Along our vibrant house reef, serene snorkeling

verified_facts.text: The resort has partnered with Reefscapers on coral reef restoration since 2023.
verified_facts.excerpt: Through our partnership with Reefscapers since 2023, The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort is committed to protecting and nurturing local coral reefs.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join the resort's marine biologist at the dive centre to help build a coral frame.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can join Hazel by the dive centre to help put together a coral frame

verified_facts.text: Bicycles are provided for every villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: With bicycles provided for every villa, guests can explore Vommuli Island at their leisure

verified_facts.text: The resort has tennis and padel courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: our tennis and padel courts offer opportunities for recreation

verified_facts.text: The complimentary Children's Club is monitored at all times by professional childcare attendants.
verified_facts.excerpt: The club is monitored at all times by professional childcare attendants.

verified_facts.text: The recreation centre has a pirate ship playground and a teens' Socialite Club with pool table and video games.
verified_facts.excerpt: a pirate ship playground outside. For teens, the Socialite Club is the ultimate holiday hangout with a pool table, chess station and video games

verified_facts.text: There is a strict no-drone policy at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: there is a strict no drone policy at The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is not technically wheelchair accessible, though it takes steps to help, such as ramps at some restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: While it is not technically a wheelchair-accessible resort, the hotel will take necessary steps to make it as easy as possible for guests.

verified_facts.text: Restaurant dress code is Resort Casual; swimwear and gym attire are discouraged.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are invited to dress in Resort Casual attire

verified_facts.text: Select dining venues may pause operations on certain days during the season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that select venues may pause operations on certain days throughout the season.

verified_facts.text: The resort produces its own Fen still and sparkling water in an on-island bottling plant, with $3 per bottle going to reef restoration.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our new bottling plant produces Fen signature still & sparkling water, decreasing our carbon footprint. For every bottle sold, $3 goes to our “Blue Fund”, supporting reef rejuvenation with local organization Reefscapers.

verified_facts.text: The resort is Green Globe Certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: Green Globe Certified
